About IIL

A Second Chance, Done Properly

Started on 18 September 2000. IIL guides weak students, dropouts and underprivileged learners to complete their education with confidence.

Why Students Choose IIL

  • Experienced NIOS faculty and proven track record of results
  • Flexible schedules — ideal for working students
  • Complete support — from form filling to exam preparation
  • Personal counseling, mentorship and complete career guidance
  • Easy admission — minimal documentation, full process handled for you
  • Around 2,000 students now serving in hospitality, aviation, judiciary and more, worldwide

NIOS is a national board under the Ministry of Education. Its certificate is valid for all colleges, jobs and competitive exams across India.

Failed in board exams? IIL guides students on saving a year with the credit transfer facility, as listed on its admission guidance.
